svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: 22 technologies. Frontend & mobile: React, Next.js, React Native, TypeScript, Vue, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, Storybook. Backend: Node.js, Express, NestJS, Django Ninja, Python, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB. Cloud & delivery: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Datadog, Sentry.
